description: Fetches 1 to 48 public image URLs and returns the pictures; nothing is stored. Up to 4 come back full size (an SVG also returns the start of its source); more come back on contact sheets, each a grid of pictures, each under its number (`n`; numbers run on across calls), with a gray checkerboard where a picture is transparent. Import the good ones with `websiteAssets.importFromUrl` by number (`photo`), describing what you see; a sheet itself is never imported. MCP clients that render images get the pictures as images; others get base64 WebP in `pictures`. Not billed to credits.

urls.description: Absolute public image URLs to look at: up to 4 come back full size, more come back on numbered contact sheets.

websiteId.description: A website you can edit; its organization pays for the call in AI credits.
